PATTERN: `npm run setup` reads ~/.claude/settings.json, merges pixel-office PreToolUse/PostToolUse/etc. entries as inline command strings (not file paths), skips if already registered, handles existing hooks safely. `npm run uninstall` removes only pixel-office entries.

WHY: Copying hook files to ~/.claude/hooks/ causes drift from repo source and fragile jq merging. Inline commands mean the code in settings.json IS the code — no separate files to sync.

GOTCHA: Setup script updates existing hooks (not just add-if-missing) — safe to re-run to pick up timeout/command changes. Users who have old 30s timeout hooks can just re-run setup.

FILES: scripts/setup.ts, bin.ts (bin entry for npx), package.json bin field
